## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing and SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND shows stocks outperforming bonds, but rising credit stress via HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL; LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND) keeps the signal mixed.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: Credit spread +0.92% week and LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds supportive: SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND) ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-tightening: Dollar strength Level 28.39 (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND, yield curve compressing (Level 1.0316 ↓ falling) and TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech and Financials showing relative strength but breadth narrow: XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND; Energy XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) in RECOVERY. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given 4/11 positive sectors.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US leadership but selective: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +2.61%) ABOVE TREND; EM EEM (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -2.76%) RECOVERY show pockets of global catch-up while Europe lags (Europe vs US ↓ falling).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation cooling: Speculation Index ↓ falling and IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +6.99%) CORRECTION, but crypto demand remains illustrated by IBIT (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Copper/industrial signals mixed: CPER (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -1.58%) RECOVERY; gold GLD (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND showing weakness while agri/weat WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND shows strength.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy bid but uneven: XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY, while natural gas UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +2.61%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND align on risk tilt; DIVERGENCE: sector breadth weak (4/11) and multiple CORRECTION signals across IWM, ARKK, XBI — monitor for breadth deterioration.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor selective exposure to high-quality cyclicals and tech strength (XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to small-cap and commodity beta (IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION; UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND); bonds neutral but watch LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If credit stabilizes and risk tone holds → XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: If breadth rolls over → IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION and XME (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy if demand surprises → XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: Natural gas downside to persist → UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), SPY/TLT momentum above current slope (SPY/TLT ↑ rising), XLK/XLF ~3.33 (current tilt toward growth vs financials).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX BELOW TREND and SPY ABOVE TREND provide offsetting confirmations while credit stress shows strain. XLK and XLF are showing relative strength, but narrow breadth and multiple CORRECTIONs (IWM, ARKK, XBI) are the key divergence to monitor.
